items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Yeah, Willie Humphrey, he'd chair me all around there.

ctx.x: I had dinner with a woman for his son of the rest.
Yeah, Willie Humphrey, he'd chair me all around there. We're not teaching that band here. I wanted to see the old man. I went to see the old man too, stroke. I didn't know the old man had a stroke.
